title: How many shrimp per year will be covered by SWP's Humane Slaughter Initiative agreements on July 1, 2027?
resolution_criteria: This question will resolve as the Shrimp Welfare Project's estimated "[Shrimpact](https://www.shrimpwelfareproject.org/shrimpact)" (in billions of shrimp helped in expectation per year) when checked by Metaculus on or soon after July 1, 2027.
fine_print:
The question will resolve as the headline estimated Shrimpact, regardless of any estimated range. If SWP ceases to provide a headline estimate and instead provides only a range, however, the question will resolve as the midpoint of the range.

The total Shrimpact will be rounded, if necessary, to the nearest 100 million shrimp.
background:
The [Shrimp Welfare Project](https://www.shrimpwelfareproject.org/) (SWP) s a United Kingdom–based charity founded in 2021 that is "[dedicated exclusively to improving the welfare of farmed shrimps."](https://animalcharityevaluators.org/charity-review/shrimp-welfare-project/) Although shrimp are perhaps not the most sympathetic farm animal, and it is believed that they do not suffer [as intensely](https://rethinkpriorities.org/research-area/welfare-range-estimates/) as humans or more intelligent farm animals like pigs, they arguably [make up for those deficiencies](https://www.currentaffairs.org/news/shrimp-are-the-most-abused-animals-on-earth) in their sheer numbers. [According to SWP](https://www.shrimpwelfareproject.org/), 440 billion shrimp are farmed each year, "more than 5x the total number of all farmed land animals combined."

Consequently, [some have concluded](https://benthams.substack.com/p/the-best-charity-isnt-what-you-think) that one of the most effective charitable interventions is the promotion of the use of electric stunners on shrimp farms, so that the billions of shrimp headed for slaughter each year "[experience minimal stress and pain](https://www.shrimpwelfareproject.org/humane-slaughter-initiative)" when they are killed.

To that end, the SWP's Humane Slaughter Initiative provides electrical stunners and "technical guidance" to shrimp producers who partner with them. As of September 2026, SWP currently estimates the "shrimpact" of its initiative at 6.3 billion shrimp helped "in expectation" (i.e., once all of its producer partners are using the electrical stunning equipment) per year.
